label: type IIG restriction-modification system
definition: A restriction-modification system in which an organism possesses a Type IIG locus centered on a restriction-methyltransferase-specificity fusion gene represented by DefenseFinder as the RM_Type_IIG subsystem.
observations: Type IIG restriction-modification branch under restriction-modification system; distinct from individual Type IIG enzymes, individual companion methyltransferases, the DefenseFinder RM_Type_IIG__Type_IIG profile group, the eight custom RM_Type_IIG HMM profiles, the RM_Type_IIG source key, BpuSI or Tth111II biochemistry outside a complete Type IIG locus, and the broader restriction-modification parent.
